newsitem.title: USA: Atchison files to register 3.8 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Atchison files to register 3.8 mln shares.

text.p: Atchison Casting Corp filed Monday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register 3.8 million common shares, of which it will sell 2,029,024 shares and the Boston-based investment partnership, Riverside Fund I, LP will offer the 1,770,976 shares it holds.
The Atchison, Kansas-based casting company said it will use the proceeds from the shares it sells to reduce debt incurred from industry-related acquisitions and to fund future acquisitions.
Underwriters for the offering are Smith Barney Inc and George K. Baum & Co. They have an over-allotment option of up to 570,000 shares, according to the SEC filing.
Atchison produces iron, steel and non-ferrous castings for equipment, capital goods and consumer markets.
